decisions.reason: Requiring full physical access to the ESP32-S3 pins does not change any existing functional GPIO assignment.
The source retains the ESP32-S3 platform but does not change the selected WROOM-1 module model or part number.
Buttons are mentioned only as an example of future platform reuse; the current panel-control connector inventory and placement policy remain unchanged.
The breakout decision does not alter I2C pull-ups, series resistors, topology, speed, or cable assumptions.
Full ESP32-S3 pin breakout and generic platform reuse do not change the existing USB data routing, connector, or programming-port behavior.
The source concerns the main-board ESP32 breakout; it does not change the sensor-board connector fanout or its individual JST connector policy.
The breakout and platform-reuse decision does not change DCDC1 voltage, capacity, compensation, or powered-load requirements.
The source does not change standalone USB power activation, regulator selection, source OR-ing, or powered-rail coverage.
Full access to ESP32-S3 pins does not alter the existing GPIO5-controlled 5V boost behavior or its powered loads.
The source does not change the charge-status LED method, GPIO, connector, resistor, or population requirements.
The ESP32 breakout decision is unrelated to the battery NTC connector and AXP2101 thermal-protection behavior.
The source concerns a main-board ESP32 breakout and does not modify the power-board connector placement, orientation, or accessibility policy.
